label: Country code
definition: The country the institution belongs to, as a three-letter code (KEN is Kenya).

label: Institution type
values: one of the 36 types in strategic-institutions.csv
definition: The kind of institution, such as Central Bank or Defence.

label: Domains scanned
definition: The institution's internet domains that the scan started from.

label: Names found
definition: How many different web and mail names the scan found under the institution's domains.

label: Working addresses
definition: How many address, mail-server and name-server records led to a working server. Every share in this file is a share of this number.

label: On US cloud
definition: Share of working addresses on Amazon, Microsoft, Google or Oracle cloud, wherever the data centre is.

label: US cloud in Africa
definition: Share of working addresses on those US cloud companies' African data centres. It is part of the US cloud share, not added to it.

label: US online services
definition: Share of working addresses on US online services such as Microsoft 365 or Salesforce.

label: Behind a shield
definition: Share of working addresses behind a shield such as Cloudflare or Akamai, which hides the real host. Any of these could also be on US cloud.

label: Government or own systems
definition: Share of working addresses on a government data centre or the institution's own network.

label: Not identified
definition: How many working addresses no source could place. A count

label: Email provider
definition: Who receives the institution's email, from its mail records. m365: Microsoft 365. google: Google. self: the institution's own servers. none: no mail record on the domain scanned. other: another provider, named after the colon.

label: Mail filter
definition: A mail security service the mail passes through first, such as mimecast or proofpoint. It can hide which provider holds the mailboxes. Blank if none seen.

label: Mixed home and US cloud
definition: true where the institution has at least one address on a government data centre or its own network and at least one on US cloud.

label: Scan date
definition: The day the institution was scanned. Every figure is as of this date.
